label: Chainlink CRE requirements
summary: Atomic EVM-only requirements for a CRE workflow. Select it through --chainlink-product cre; this definition does not prove DON execution, consensus or provider support.
requiredFacts: Selected Go or TypeScript runtime with exact SDK and compiler versions, workflow artifact and configuration hashes, workflow identity, target, DON and trigger
TypeScript QuickJS and WASM restrictions including unavailable Node built-ins and randomnessSource not-used, or the separately bound Go randomness mode
Deterministic time, randomness, consensus aggregation and scaled integer or decimal arithmetic inputs
Bounded network and data work, retry and idempotency, report verification, secrets by reference and terminal recovery
Local simulation classified only as single-node tooling evidence rather than DON execution or consensus evidence
requiredFiles: Content-addressed EVM-only Chainlink provider profile selecting CRE
Workflow source, artifact, configuration, dependency lock and compiler or SDK receipts
Trigger, target, workflow and DON identity configuration
Secrets-reference, report-verification, retry and terminal-recovery policies
requiredTests: Wrong workflow, artifact, configuration, compiler, SDK, target, DON and trigger identity
Runtime-specific unavailable API, nondeterministic input and arithmetic-scale behavior
Duplicate, reordered, retried, timed-out and partially completed workflow execution
Bounded network calls, response bytes, retries and total work
Simulation evidence cannot be promoted to DON execution, consensus, deployment or provider-support evidence
risks: A local single-node simulation can be overstated as distributed execution evidence
TypeScript code can assume Node APIs that QuickJS and WASM do not provide
Unbounded external work or retries can break liveness and cost limits
Mutable workflow or DON identity can rewrite the reviewed trust boundary
